name: हिन्दी
label: हि
howTo: Type Hindi by how it sounds, in English letters: namaste becomes नमस्ते. Capitals are sounds of their own (namaH, maChiyoM), so Shift changes the letter. The bar starts with what Space will write, then words that fit, then a likely word if you slipped. Tap one to pick it, or swipe up for more. Double Space types "। ", and a word ending in ~ keeps its last virama (agar~).
